clue.text: 24 fortress and eastern state

parts.note: a castle is a fortified stronghold

clue.text: Bog standard menu?

explanation.definitionFit: Ready meals and fast food are the ordinary, quick-to-prepare fare of a standard menu, and a bog is a convenience.
